verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares is a SaaS equity-management platform that holds sensitive cap-table and document data, so data retention and deletion controls are a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence pack never mentions retention settings, deletion controls, or data-purge capabilities. The data-room and document-organization items describe collecting and linking documents, not removing them or controlling how long they are kept.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
